title: Clockstream
summary: Start: enter the system. The log opens Clockstream and the helm marks Clock Rock. Do: Close on Clock Rock. The meteor stream has a period. A probe that sits in the window becomes Missed Windows. Do not park in the vector. Finish: come inside Clock Rock's shell. A drift rumor. The window still kills a parked probe. Fail: there is no timer. Leave and the job stays open until you close.
